text:
jin: FYI vendor pen-test booked for Tue 2026-05-05 08:00-16:00 PT. Need quick ops checklist: ephemeral RBAC, KMS grant scoping, immutable log snapshot, remediation tracker and retest slots.

tara: Which envs are in-scope?

jin: Staging + staging-canary route only. No full-prod. Scope doc on vault: https://internal.redwood/pt/2026-05-scope (restricted)

sam: RBAC idea: create timebound role `pt-assessor-<id>` with minimal read perms, max TTL=4h. Approval required from @sania.

sania: Fine. Approve CLI/API only, no console. KMS: grant kms:Decrypt for the ephemeral principal but deny kms:CreateGrant and kms:CreateKey. Log GrantCreate/Retire in CloudTrail.

evidence-bot: Created tracker ticket SEC-PT-2026-0505-T1. Upload path template: s3://redwood-pt-evidence/SEC-PT-2026-0505/<finding>/

jin: Packaging rules: presigned uploads, manifest.csv (cols: finding-id, service, pr, deploy-id, logs-path, sha256). Leah/Ash can we get presign flow?

tara: I'll ask deploy-bot to pre-generate presigned URLs for the role. deploy-bot: ping with `!prepare pt-assessor-<id>` and I'll create URLs and whitelist IPs.

deploy-bot: ACK.

sam: Minimal IAM example for ops review:
```json
{"Version":"2012-10-17","Statement":[{"Effect":"Allow","Action":["logs:DescribeLogGroups","logs:GetLogEvents","s3:GetObject"],"Resource":"arn:aws:logs:*:*:*"},{"Effect":"Allow","Action":["kms:Decrypt"],"Resource":"arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:123456789012:key/EXAMPLEKEY"}]}
```

sania: Retention: immutable s3 export for 180 days, plus 14-day SIEM hot window. Export prefix: s3://redwood-pt-archives/SEC-PT-2026-0505/YYYYMMDD/

jin: Triage flow: 0-24h -> security on-call (sania) does initial bucket by severity and assigns SE owner. 24-72h -> assigned eng owner implements fix, adds evidence to tracker. Criticals aim for patch within 48h when possible.

tara: Retest scheduling: open retest window 5 business days after report uploaded. Reserve two 2-hour slots/week for 3 weeks. Vendor requests slot in tracker.

sam: We'll need a QA regression checklist before retest signoff. I'll drop a template in this thread.

evidence-bot: Reminder scheduled: 24h before engagement to verify ephemeral role TTL.

sania: One constraint: no infra-level key rotations during window. If rotation is required, coordinate with security and SRE.

jin: Action items:
- sania: sign ephemeral role + KMS grant policy (today)
- tara: request presigned URL prep from deploy-bot (tomorrow)
- sam: QA regression checklist + manifest template (EOD)
- jin: reserve retest slots in tracker and notify vendor

sam: Quick Q: can assessors pull full CloudTrail event history or only filtered events?

sania: Filtered read-only access to CloudTrail for the engagement, full exports go to the archive bucket.

tara: Noted. Anything else before I trigger `!prepare`?

jin: That's it. I'll post a concise runbook to #incidents once the role and presign flow are in place. React with :white_check_mark: when your task is done.

sania: :white_check_mark:

tara: :white_check_mark:

sam: :white_check_mark:
